$comment: Seed data extracted from JNIC directorate handbooks. One entry per directorate; all flow through the same generic report/engine model. Source docs: JNIC_Directorate_XX_*.docx

directorates.name: Administration Directorate
directorates.mandate: Provide the secretariat, records, legal and systems support that keeps the church organised and compliant.

desks.name: Secretariat and Correspondence
duties: Run HQ secretariat, minutes and official letters.
Issue notices for meetings.

desks.name: Records and Registry
duties: Maintain the central registry of branches, pastors and units.
Control official records and document filing.

desks.name: Legal and Compliance
duties: Ensure legal registration and regulatory compliance.
Review contracts with the legal adviser.

desks.name: Events and Calendar
duties: Keep the annual calendar.
Coordinate meetings and church events.

desks.name: ICT and Data Systems
duties: Manage the reporting platform and databases.
Protect data and ensure data protection compliance.

kpis: Meetings held on schedule and minutes issued within 7 days
Report submission rate through the platform

D2: Meetings held and minutes issued within 7 days
Report submission rate on the platform

directorates.name: Missions Directorate
directorates.mandate: Coordinate evangelism, church planting and outreach so the gospel reaches new people and places.

director.name: Pst Victor Eyo / Rev Imikan Etebom

desks.name: Evangelism and Outreach
duties: Plan and coordinate outreaches, crusades and campaigns.
Provide materials and training for outreach units.

desks.name: Church Planting and Expansion
duties: Assess sites and launch new churches.
Support new churches with leaders and resources.

desks.name: Follow-up and Discipleship
duties: Run the follow-up system from first contact to membership.
Train follow-up workers and track converts.

desks.name: Missions Partnerships
duties: Build and manage partnerships with missions bodies.
Coordinate joint outreaches and support.

desks.name: Mission Fields Welfare
duties: Support the welfare of missionaries and mission fields.
Report conditions and needs to the Director.

D1: New converts recorded (names and contacts on separate sheet)
Converts integrated into groups or classes

directorates.name: Operations Directorate
directorates.mandate: Define and standardise how things are done in the commission, and ensure everyday compliance with approved procedures in every department, service unit and branch.

desks.name: SOPs and Standardisation
duties: Develop, issue and review SOPs for every process.
Standardise forms, workflows and routines.

desks.name: Compliance and Quality Assurance
duties: Run routine compliance checks and inspections.
Record deviations and follow up corrective action.

desks.name: Departments and Service Units Coordination
duties: Monitor daily activities of departments and units against plans.
Resolve operational overlaps and gaps.

desks.name: Security and Protocol
duties: Set security and protocol standards.
Set and test emergency response procedures.

branchUnits: SOP Champions and Compliance Officers (one per unit)
All service units and departments (SOP compliance)
kpis: SOPs issued and reviewed on schedule
Branches and units compliant with SOPs (%)
Service unit and department activity reports received
directorates.governanceNote: Operations oversees compliance across ALL service units — read-side visibility may cross directorate boundaries (unique: every other directorate sees only its own units).

D1: SOPs applied this week and any deviations
D2: Compliance rate by branch and unit

directorates.name: Finance and Accounts Directorate
directorates.mandate: Safeguard, account for and grow the church's financial resources with transparency and integrity.

desks.name: Treasury and Banking
duties: Manage bank accounts, signatories and cash handling rules.
Process remittances and approve payments.

desks.name: Budget and Planning
duties: Prepare national and branch budget guidelines.
Track budget performance and variances monthly.

desks.name: Accounting and Reporting
duties: Maintain the books and consolidate branch returns.
Produce monthly and annual financial statements.

desks.name: Internal Audit and Compliance
duties: Plan and run scheduled and surprise audits.
Follow up and close audit exceptions.

desks.name: Welfare and Benevolence Funds
duties: Administer welfare, benevolence and special funds.
Verify and report all disbursements.

directorates.governanceNote: D1 requires evidence fields (deposit slip numbers, receipts attached) — report templates need attachment support. Internal audit (scheduled + surprise) is a real workflow worth its own module later.

D1: Offerings and tithes banked (amount, date, deposit slip no.)
Cash on hand at week end

directorates.name: Music and Worship Directorate
directorates.mandate: Lead the commission's music ministry and the technical delivery of worship, with excellence, unity and doctrinal soundness across all branches.

desks.name: Choirs and Music
duties: Set standards for choirs, singers and music directors, including approved songs.
Train, audition and certify choir leaders and music directors.
Coordinate choir programmes, rehearsal guides and festivals.

desks.name: Instrumentation and Sound
duties: Set standards for instruments, sound systems and service audio.
Train and certify instrumentalists and sound engineers.
Advise branches on equipment selection and sound setup.

desks.name: Media and Projection
duties: Set standards for projecting lyrics, scriptures and visuals during services.
Train projection and presentation operators.
Work with the Media and Communications Directorate so projection matches broadcast and branding.

kpis: Music, sound and projection workers trained and certified
Branches meeting sound and projection standards

D1: Services held and units on duty (choir, band, sound, projection)
Instrument, sound or projection equipment issues
New members recruited into the units
D2: Units active per branch (choir, instrumentation, sound, projection)
Service quality audit scores (music, sound, projection)

directorates.name: Kingdom Business and Investment Directorate
directorates.mandate: Steward and grow the commission's school and other investments, and establish new businesses and investments that strengthen the commission's finances and advance its mission.

desks.name: School Management and Expansion
duties: Manage the primary and secondary school.
Lead expansion to all JNIC locations and beyond.

desks.name: Business Development and New Ventures
duties: Identify, evaluate and launch new businesses.
Prepare business plans for approval.

desks.name: Investment Portfolio and Performance
duties: Manage the existing investments.
Track returns and report to the Executive Council.

desks.name: Governance, Risk and Due Diligence
duties: Run due diligence and risk assessment.
Enforce business governance and legal compliance.

desks.name: Partnerships and Funding
duties: Source partners, investors and funding.
Manage partnership agreements.

kpis: Business plans approved with due diligence
directorates.governanceNote: Significant investments above a Council-set limit require Executive Council approval. School expansion is a stated goal: school may eventually warrant its own entity in the model.

directorates.name: Human Resource Directorate
directorates.mandate: Recruit, train, deploy, care for and hold accountable the church's pastors, workers and leaders.

desks.name: Recruitment and Deployment
duties: Recruit and deploy pastors and workers.
Manage directorate assignments and transfers.

desks.name: Training and Academy
duties: Run the ministerial academy and continuing education.
Certify completion of training.

desks.name: Ethics, Conduct and Discipline
duties: Administer the code of conduct.
Handle disciplinary cases with the Senior Pastor.

desks.name: Pastoral Welfare and Care
duties: Coordinate welfare for pastors and families.
Provide pastoral care for workers.

desks.name: Records and Appraisal
duties: Keep personnel records.
Run mid-year and year-end appraisals.

directorates.governanceNote: HR Development owns directorate assignments and transfers. Discipline/welfare report fields are deliberately non-identifying (confidential sheet, no personal details) — privacy rules needed in the data model.

directorates.name: Media and Communications Directorate
directorates.mandate: Tell the church's story and keep members, the public and leadership informed through accurate, timely and consistent communication.

desks.name: Broadcast and Production
duties: Run live streaming, TV and radio production.
Set technical standards for branch media units.

desks.name: Digital and Social Media
duties: Manage the website and social media platforms.
Publish the approved content calendar.

desks.name: Publications and Public Relations
duties: Produce publications and press statements.
Handle media relations with Senior Pastor approval.

desks.name: Internal Communications
duties: Circulate announcements between HQ, regions and branches.
Maintain official communication channels.

desks.name: Archives and Branding
duties: Archive sermons, events and official media.
Enforce branding standards.

directorates.governanceNote: Sensitive publications/press statements require Senior Pastor approval.

directorates.name: Family and Ministries Directorate
directorates.mandate: Nurture every age group and fellowship: children, teens, youth, men and women.

desks.name: Children's Church
duties: Provide curriculum and safe programmes for children.
Train and screen children's workers.

desks.name: Teens Ministry
duties: Run teens programmes and mentoring.
Train teens leaders.

desks.name: Youth Ministry
duties: Run youth programmes, events and discipleship.
Develop youth leaders.

desks.name: Men's Fellowship
duties: Plan men's programmes and events.
Coordinate regional and national meetings.

desks.name: Women's Fellowship
duties: Plan women's programmes and events.
Coordinate regional and national meetings.

D1: Meetings held and attendance by group
Welfare or counselling referrals (no personal details)

directorates.name: Works and Infrastructure Directorate
directorates.mandate: Plan, deliver and maintain the physical infrastructure of the commission so that every location has safe, sound and fit-for-purpose facilities.

desks.name: Planning and Design
duties: Prepare the infrastructure master plan.
Commission designs and cost estimates.

desks.name: Construction and Project Delivery
duties: Manage construction from approvals to handover.
Report project progress.

desks.name: Property, Land and Facilities Management
duties: Handle land titles, surveys and approvals with Administration.
Run planned maintenance of facilities.

desks.name: Assets and Procurement of Works
duties: Maintain the asset register.
Run transparent tendering with Finance and Accounts.

desks.name: Safety and Building Standards
duties: Set building, health and safety standards.
Check contractor and site compliance.

kpis: Projects delivered on time and within budget
directorates.councilApprovalNote: Capital projects above a limit set by the Council require Executive Council approval.

D2: Projects on time and within budget

fields: Key figures (consolidated from D1 and D2 reports)

D4.name: Monthly Directorate Report
fields: Decisions required from the Senior Pastor or Council

fields: Mandate and objectives for the year
